record.question: In the context of the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) monetary policy operations, a sustained period of increasing Repo Rate is generally expected to have which of the following effects on the Indian economy? (i) Dampen demand-pull inflation by increasing the cost of borrowing and investment. (ii) Reduce the net interest margin (NIM) of commercial banks that rely heavily on deposits for funding. (iii) Lead to an appreciation of the Indian Rupee against major global currencies. (iv) Encourage a shift in household savings from market-linked instruments to bank fixed deposits.
